story: More liberals, people of color and LGBTQ say they're buying guns out of fear
text: The whole topic reminds me of Deviant Ollam's talk "Lawyer. Passport. Locksmith. Gun." ( [VIDEO] ) He spends a fair amount of time talking about getting his queer and trans friends interested in guns. I suspect this has been the trend for a few years, at least. He includes a quote that is rather salient: "If you do not have the means of violence, you aren't peaceful; you're harmless."
